title: Implement public Series discovery UI
description: Implement approved Series discovery, detail, reader context, SEO, and validation from specs/015-series-learning-path without regressing existing blog or owner flows.
acceptance_criteria: Complete frontend T019-T034 with focused tests, typecheck, lint, build, and responsive accessibility review.

title: Fix production routing for series pages
description: Production SEO gateway classifies /series/manage and /series/:slug as not-found before React loads. Add route-policy coverage and regression tests so the protected management page and public series page receive the SPA shell.
acceptance_criteria: GET /series/manage returns a private noindex SPA shell instead of 404; GET /series/:slug returns an app shell instead of 404; targeted SEO route and server tests pass.
close_reason: Implemented SEO gateway series route classification, added regressions, and verified tests/typecheck/build/local production responses.

title: Consume RBAC authorization in web app
description: Implement approved specs/012-rbac-authorization across private auth state, permission-aware routes and controls, 403 recovery, and minimal admin role assignment UI.
acceptance_criteria: Member, author, and admin UI behavior follows backend permissions; 403 never signs out; authoring loss preserves work; admin role assignment states are handled; tests, typecheck, lint, and build pass.

title: Implement browser authentication session lifecycle
description: Implement specs/013-authentication-session-lifecycle with in-memory access tokens, cookie refresh, one retry, cross-tab coordination, logout, Google callback, and validation.
acceptance_criteria: All tasks in specs/013-authentication-session-lifecycle/tasks.md complete; tests, type-check, lint, and production build pass before backend TTL cutover.
close_reason: Browser authentication lifecycle implementation and validation complete.

title: Implement blog comments across backend and reader
description: Deliver the approved authenticated blog comments feature across horizon-blog-be and horizon-blog. Follow backend specs/005-blog-comments and frontend specs/010-blog-comments. Preserve public reads, two reply levels, owner moderation, retry idempotency, and article failure isolation.
design: Backend owns API, auth, cursor pagination, tombstones, and capabilities. Frontend uses feature-local repository/service/hook/components in the existing reader layout.
acceptance_criteria: Backend and frontend task trackers complete; focused and full quality gates pass; migrations are created but not executed without owner approval.
notes: Implementation complete in backend and frontend. FE: 165 tests, typecheck, lint, build passed. BE: 11 focused tests and go vet passed; full non-DB packages passed. Remaining release verification requires PostgreSQL on localhost:5433 for test and test/analytics; no migration or Docker command was run.

title: Build Series UI
description: Add public series route, article series context, local reading progress, and owner series management using the backend contract.
acceptance_criteria: Readers can browse a series and navigate previous/next; owners can manage series order; UI is responsive and accessible; tests, lint, typecheck, and build pass.

title: Encode public blog post URLs
description: Replace obvious numeric public /blog/:id URLs with stable opaque post codes across React navigation and the SEO gateway while preserving numeric backend APIs and legacy route compatibility.
design: Use a deterministic reversible local codec with fixed constants and no new production dependency. Keep analytics/profile/internal API identifiers numeric.
acceptance_criteria: All public article links and canonical/discovery URLs use stable opaque codes; direct encoded routes resolve the existing numeric post API; legacy numeric public routes redirect; focused frontend and SEO tests pass.
notes: Implemented fixed p+9 base62 public post codes shared by React and the SEO gateway. Numeric reader routes 301 to coded paths; numeric backend, image, profile, analytics, interaction, and related-post boundaries remain unchanged. Validation: 77 focused tests, tsc, lint, build, and diff check passed.

title: Refactor landing story card to inset panel
description: Replace the current split landing StoryCard with approved Option C: a large uncropped cover and an inset information panel, while preserving metadata, fallback, responsive behavior, and navigation.
design: Use semantic Chakra tokens, a 16:9 contained cover, and a raised bg.elevated information panel that overlaps the cover without obscuring important edges.
acceptance_criteria: StoryCard uses a cover-led inset panel at desktop and a readable stacked treatment on mobile; full cover remains visible; focused tests, typecheck, and lint pass.
close_reason: Implemented Option C cover-first inset information panel and passed focused tests, typecheck, lint, formatting, and diff checks.

value: Spec Kit remains the durable source for feature specifications, plans, tasks, and approved designs. Use Beads for operational issue tracking and cross-session project memory; repository AGENTS.md rules override conflicting bd prime defaults.
